incident-bot: ALERT: spike in 5xx rate for /v1/generate — 5m error_rate=1.8% (>0.5% alert threshold). Paging oncall_emily.

2026-03-14T08:21:12Z ERROR handler.go:234 request_id=abc123 status=502 upstream=overflow
... (repeated)```

sachin: FYI we have an autoscale event around the time but GPU utilization still high. Suggest immediate mitigation: route non-critical traffic to fallback-model-small and scale up pool-2 by +2 nodes.
emily: doing a fast ramp: `/infra scale gpu-pool-2 +2 --reason incident-1955551234` (runbook step 2)

python tools/warm_kv.py --keys-file /tmp/hot_keys.txt --pool gpu-pool-2
``` 
jane: I can prep the keys list, pulling top prompt prefixes from logs.
andrew: also recommend short-term routing rule: any request with header `X-Client-Tier: free` -> route to fallback-model-small. Patch: ```yaml
routes:
  - match: header:X-Client-Tier==free
    action: route:fallback-model-small
    ttl: 10m
```
emily: patch applied, will monitor.

omar: good. proposal for postmortem and alert tuning:
- reduce noise: change non-prod alert thresholds to 2% error_rate and exclude fallback-model-small.
- production alert: change error_rate alert to a 5m rolling window with increase-of-x rule instead of static >0.5% for routes with <1rps.
- add golden signals panel group to incident dashboard (error rate, p95 latency, queue depth, GPU util, cache hit% and routing fallbacks)
- add quick drilldown links from error-rate panel to logs/Loki query and to request traces in Jaeger.
sachin: I'll own dashboard build. plan:
1) Create `incident/retrospective/1955551234` dashboard folder
2) Panels:
   - Error rate heatmap (by route)
   - p95 latency time-series + annotation for scale events

   - GPU utilization per node

3) Add panel action: click -> logs query: ```loki
{app="redwood"} |= "502" | json | line_format "{{ .request_id }} {{ .route }} {{ .msg }}"
```
4) Drilldown to traces: link to `https://tracing.company.local/trace/{{request_id}}`
jane: timeline notes for retro: scale up at t+3m, routing rule applied at t+5m, error drop t+7m. we'll annotate.

- prod error-rate: keep threshold 0.5% but add `increase_by: 200% over 10m` condition to avoid flapping on tiny baselines.
- nonprod error-rate: raise to 2% and add `min_requests: 100`.
- queue-depth alert: change from absolute 500 -> 1000 for gpu-pool-2 until autoscale cadence is improved.
